effects.does: Clicking it opens the Clara assistant.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event data changes.
effects.check: Click Ask Clara and verify that the assistant drawer opens without changing the drafts list.

effects.does: Clicking it opens the event-creation screen.
effects.affects: Nothing is added to the event records until the buyer completes and saves or publishes the event.
effects.check: Click Create Event M and verify that the event-creation screen is displayed.

effects.does: Clicking it switches the list to live events.
effects.affects: The visible event list changes from drafts to live events.
effects.check: Click Live 8583 and verify that live events are shown and the Live tab is selected.

effects.does: Clicking it switches the list to historical events.
effects.affects: The visible event list changes from drafts to historical events.
effects.check: Click History 2035 and verify that historical events are shown and the History tab is selected.

effects.does: It keeps the buyer on the drafts view.
effects.affects: The visible event list is filtered to draft events and no event data is modified.
effects.check: Verify that Drafts 183 is selected and only draft events are displayed.

effects.does: Clicking it switches the list to recurring events.
effects.affects: The visible event list changes from drafts to recurring events.
effects.check: Click Recurring and verify that recurring events are shown and the Recurring tab is selected.

effects.does: Entering text filters the displayed events by title.
effects.affects: Only matching event records remain visible in the current drafts list; event data is not changed.
effects.check: Enter a known draft title and verify that matching titles remain while nonmatching titles are hidden.

cases.title: Ask Clara opens the assistant
gaps: Assert that the Clara assistant opened: the catalog provides no assistant-specific assertion or confirmed label identifying its open panel.

cases.title: Live 8583 shows live events
cases.expected: Live 8583 becomes selected and the list shows live events instead of drafts.
gaps: Assert that the Live tab becomes selected; the catalog has no selected-tab assertion.
Verify that the resulting rows are live events rather than drafts; the prepared event is a draft, and no known live event or row-status selector is supplied.

cases.title: History 2035 shows historical events
cases.expected: History 2035 becomes selected and the list shows historical events instead of drafts.

steps.note: Start with Drafts selected, as required by the setup.
Select History without hard-coding the dynamic event count.
Verify the active destination is the historical-events list rather than Drafts.
Verify the destination list rendered without an error.

cases.title: Recurring shows recurring events
cases.expected: Recurring becomes selected and the recurring-events list opens.
gaps: Assert that Recurring is the selected tab; no catalog assertion reads a tab's selected state.
Assert that the recurring-events list specifically opened without assuming it is empty or inventing a list locator or route.

cases.title: Search Title filters draft events
cases.expected: Only matching draft events remain visible in the list. Non-matching drafts are hidden.
cases.setup: Load /orders with Drafts 183 selected. Ensure one draft title contains "Alpha" and another visible draft does not.
gaps: Ensure an Alpha-containing draft and a non-matching draft are both visible before searching; the prepared draft's title is fixed and additional fixtures cannot be created.

Assert that only Alpha-matching draft rows remain and previously visible non-matching drafts disappear without known fixture titles or an assertion that checks every result row against the search query.
